description: Texas Commission on Environmental Quality - Sanitary Sewer Overflows (SSO) is a dataset listed in State of Texas open data portal (data.texas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Texas. An SSO is a type of unauthorized discharge of untreated or partially treated wastewater from a collection system or its components (e.g., a manhole, lift station, or cleanout) before it reaches a wastewater treatment facility. Coverage: Texas. Its tags are office of compliance and enforcement, program support & environmental assistance division, psead, oce, sanitary sewer overflow. The table has 21 columns. Attribution on the portal: Office of Compliance and Enforcement. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-texas-gov-portal.
